statistics.overview: Doesn’t win out of turn and ran below par last time when seventh over 1600m at Te Rapa and beaten 15 lengths. Drops in class, and can do much better.
Is not a prolific winner with just two victories from 23 starts. Last start finished third over 1400m at this track. Capable enough on his day and is a key runner.
Lightly raced gelding who was beaten 7 lengths into second last start over 1600m at Te Rapa. Key runner who is expected to be in the finish.
Didn't do a great deal when resuming over 1300m at this track last start, finishing 5.5 lengths away in ninth. Might need another run.
Beaten 6 lengths into fifth when resuming last start over 1300m at Cambridge Synthetic. Strips fitter and is among the chances.
Easily beaten at his last run before spelling and didn't fare any better when resuming over 1400m at Avondale a month ago, beaten 8 lengths into eighth. Can't recommend.
Struggling to find consistency. In the money two runs ago then last time was beaten 12 lengths into 15th over 1600m at Te Rapa. Needs to do more.
Recent form has been good, with a win most recently over 1600m at this track following a sound fourth at this track two starts back. Draws well and another big run is in store.
Scored when second-up at this track two runs ago then found a couple better last time at this track over 1300m. Hard to beat on her best form.
Recorded her maiden success last time out over 1400m at this track. Worth following up.
Hasn't won in two years. Finished fifth, beaten 7 lengths, last start over 2100m at this track. Has some top 4 claims.
Dual acceptor. Hasn't won in 13 months. Finished fourth, beaten 2.25 lengths, last start over 1400m at Te Aroha. Rates a top 4 hope and is worth including.
She ran on strongly to record her maiden win at this track last time out. Freshened up since that run. May well be worth following up.
Has done little to threaten in recent times. Last appeared when seventh over 1600m at this track, beaten 5 lengths. Unlikely to feature.
Made it three unplaced runs from three starts this campaign when eighth over 1600m at Te Rapa a week ago. Expect he will be a top 4 hope.

selections.name: Any of horses 4, 6, 7 or 14 to win

racecardEvent.overview: MISS SETH (9) saves her best for her home track, and followed up her upset win here 2 starts back with a fast finishing third as the favourite a fortnight ago on this track. The extra 300m is the key here, and she will again be hard to hold out. MERRIAMA (8) showed a quick turn of foot when scoring her maiden win here 2 weeks ago over this trip. She has more than 3 lengths to spare over her rivals that day, and she could well be good enough to take the next step immediately. JURISPRUDENCE (2) is a very consistent type who has been thereabouts through the winter. A former surface on this course seems to suit him, and he should be right the finish again. SUGAR DADDY (3) kept up a strong gallop when finishing second behind a runaway winner at Te Rapa 3 weeks ago. He is a progressive gelding who should figure in the top 4 here. PACT (10) built her form strongly to score here by half a length 4 weeks ago. That was her first run on a good track, and she can go on with the job.
